# The Snapfit Book (v0.1.0)

> How to build with snapfit (v0.1.0), a zero-cost, compile-time verified, pure-Rust dependency injection framework. Every example is a complete program that compiles and runs, with its recorded output shown underneath.

- [Contents](https://marlon-sousa.github.io/snapfit-rs/book/v0.1.0/index.md): every part and chapter, in reading order.
